packageRules.description: GPUI's HTTP client pulls in xattr 0.2.3, which reads libc::ENOATTR on Linux, and libc 0.2.190 removed it.
wry pins webkit2gtk 2.0.1, which links gtk 0.18, and only one gtk-sys may link gtk-3.
No test renders the UI, so a person reviews every GPUI release before it merges.
ricochet's pin decides the toolchain, because the Apple Silicon agent only has the one ricochet uses.
